items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: Barney and Whetsol and Metzel was playing the three things together

ctx.x: Oh, the stink bomb. I don't know if I should say that, because they will know who did it, then. That was at the Howard Theatre -- at the Howard Theatre, I bought one of those stink bombs, I went at intermission, and there was a place around 25th Street that sold all of those kinds of things, so I got me a couple of those, and while we were on the stage, I put one on the floor and mashed it, so naturally, the odor went all over. That's when we were playing "Moon Indigo," and the people started saying, "Oh, what…

So after a while, the man came backstage and wanted to know who the devil threw that thing over there and wanted to know if it had been anyone in the band, so of course nobody said anything about it. But he really was hot about that.
